description.en: Refundable Hawaiʻi earned income tax credit equal to 40% of the federal EITC claimed on the taxpayer’s federal return (part-year/nonresident amounts prorated by Hawaiʻi AGI / federal AGI). Claimed on Form N-356 with Schedule CR.
description.ml: Refundable Hawaiʻi earned income tax credit equal to 40% of the federal EITC claimed on the taxpayer’s federal return (part-year/nonresident amounts prorated by Hawaiʻi AGI / federal AGI). Claimed on Form N-356 with Schedule CR.

eligibility_rules.notes: HI EITC (HRS §235-55.75): must claim federal EITC and file HI return with same filing status/dependents; credit = 40% of federal EITC (prorated for part-year/NR). scheme_name.ml: Alaska Senior Citizen / Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption

description.en: Alaska law (AS 29.45.030) requires municipalities that levy property tax to exempt up to the first $150,000 of assessed value of a primary residence owned and occupied by a resident age 65 or older (and provides related paths for eligible disabled veterans and certain widows/widowers). Apply through the local municipal/borough assessor by the local deadline.

eligibility_rules.notes: AK senior exemption: municipal mandatory exemption up to $150,000 assessed value for qualifying age-65+ primary residence occupants (AS 29.45.030); disabled-veteran and widow/widower paths exist.
